ModMetaData.name: Doctor Work Split
ModMetaData.author: 9ranr11d
ModMetaData.description:
Splits the Doctor work type into three columns on the Work tab.
- Doctor: emergency and routine treatment, self-tending, animal treatment, rescue - Surgery: operations on people and animals, taking patients to bed for operations - Patient care: feeding patients and animals, administering hemogen, visiting the sick
Works with existing saves. Paramedic mechs keep all three kinds of work.
